# Pika - Customer Intelligence & Omnichannel Marketing Platform

> Pika is a B2B SaaS Customer Intelligence & Omnichannel Marketing Platform ("Müşteri Zekâsı ve Omnichannel Pazarlama Platformu") headquartered in Turkey. Pika's foundational starting point is not merely sending messages, but understanding customer, product, and transactional context.

The platform operates across a 6-step decision and execution loop:
Data & Ingestion
→ Customer & Product Intelligence
→ Opportunity & Decision (Customer Context Engine / Günün Fırsatları)
→ Audience, Campaign & Journey Orchestration
→ Channel Execution (Email, SMS, WhatsApp)
→ Analytics, BI & Learning Loop

## Overview

Pika is engineered for marketing teams, e-commerce brands, and omnichannel retailers that need to extract commercial meaning from customer and catalog data, identify high-intent revenue opportunities, and orchestrate targeted, compliant marketing communications.

Pika does not position itself as a generic bulk message broadcaster or standalone dispatcher. Instead, it unifies customer transaction histories, detects timely purchase rhythms, and executes controlled campaigns across supported channels.

### Key Capabilities

- **Customer & Product Intelligence**: Unifies customer purchase histories into Pika 360 profiles, computes RFM-based Customer Value Scores, and categorizes products by commercial intent (Need Groups, Product Roles).
- **Opportunity Detection (Günün Fırsatları)**: The Customer Context Engine (CCE) detects actionable commercial opportunities including replenishment rhythms, churn win-back, and cross-sell affinities.
- **Audience Segmentation**: Audience Manager enables dynamic rule-based segmentation using purchase recency, order frequency, monetary value, and category engagement.
- **Campaign Orchestration**: Campaign Manager coordinates multi-channel messaging schedules across Email, SMS, and WhatsApp.
- **Customer Journey Automation**: Journey Manager provides visual workflow automation for event-driven lifecycle triggers, delays, and conditional branching.
- **Content Studio**: Drag-and-drop template designer for responsive email templates and multi-channel message formatting.
- **AI Campaign Assistant (Pika Pilot)**: Assistive AI co-pilot that suggests campaign ideas, audience criteria, and draft copy from natural language prompts, with mandatory human approval. Internal product documentation describes an anonymized-parameter AI boundary in which direct personal identifiers are intended to be excluded from LLM prompt context.
- **Governed Channel Execution**: Outbound delivery across Email, SMS, and official Meta WhatsApp Business API integration with IYS status verification and opt-out workflows supporting KVKK/IYS governance context.
- **Analytics & Attribution**: Unified reporting dashboard for tracking delivery metrics, engagement rates, and store-level attribution.
- **Data Security & Privacy**: Role-based access control (RBAC) and privacy-focused operational safeguards.

### Technical Details

- **Website**: https://pika.tr
- **Application**: https://app.pika.tr
- **Supported Languages**: Turkish (tr), English (en)
- **Platform Type**: B2B SaaS
- **Target Market**: Turkey (architecture supports multi-lingual English and Turkish interfaces)
- **Execution Channels**: Email, SMS, Official Meta WhatsApp Business API. (Note: Push is CONTRADICTORY / UNCONFIRMED and is excluded from public channel/capability signals until explicit product-owner confirmation. Future confirmation may change its governance state. It must not be inferred as a live capability.)

## Solutions & Platform Modules

### Customer Intelligence
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/platform/customer-intelligence

Analytical intelligence layer that unifies transaction data to calculate Customer Value Scores (RFM), identify individual consumption rhythms, and detect churn and dormancy risks.

### Product Intelligence
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/platform/product-intelligence

Catalog enrichment engine that classifies products by Need Groups and commercial Product Roles to uncover cross-sell basket affinities and sales velocity.

### Pika 360
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/platform/pika-360

Unified customer profile cockpit displaying past order summaries, current value score, churn risk tier, communication channel permissions, and pending commercial opportunities.

### Daily Opportunities (Günün Fırsatları)
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/platform/opportunities

Algorithmic decision engine that converts customer consumption intervals and basket associations into actionable daily marketing opportunities.

### Campaign Manager
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/campaign-manager

Central hub for creating, scheduling, and managing multi-channel marketing campaigns across Email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Supports cohort binding, message scheduling, and performance monitoring.

### Audience Manager
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/audience-manager

Audience segmentation tool for building dynamic and static customer cohorts. Evaluates multi-condition rule trees using transactional history, lifecycle stages, and custom attributes.

### Journey Manager
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/journey-manager

Visual customer journey canvas for automated lifecycle flows. Supports event triggers, wait intervals, conditional checks, and multi-channel touchpoints from onboarding to retention.

### Content Studio
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/content-studio

Visual drag-and-drop template designer for crafting responsive email layouts, SMS copy, and WhatsApp message templates. Features dynamic personalization blocks and mobile preview.

### Email Marketing
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/channels/email

Transactional and marketing email delivery infrastructure. Features list management, template composition, dynamic personalization tokens, and delivery management.

### SMS Campaigns
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/channels/sms

Commercial SMS campaign dispatch. Includes message scheduling, character count calculation, delivery tracking, and automated opt-out handling.

### WhatsApp Messaging
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/channels/whatsapp

Official Meta WhatsApp Business API integration for approved outbound template messages, transactional alerts, and promotional announcements with opt-in verification.

### Analytics & Reporting
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/analytics-reporting

Unified campaign analytics and reporting dashboard. Tracks delivery rates, opens, clicks, opt-outs, and channel performance metrics.

### Consent Management
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/consent-management

Consent and preference management with IYS status verification and opt-out workflows supporting KVKK/IYS governance. Automatically checks recipient opt-in status prior to dispatch, maintains suppression lists, and syncs unsubscribe events.

### Integrations
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/integrations

Connect customer profiles, product catalogs, and transactional order data via CSV/Excel imports, REST Ingestion APIs (`/api/v1/ingest/`), and webhooks.

### Security & Privacy
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/security-and-privacy

Data security architecture featuring role-based access control (RBAC), tokenized integrations, and secure operational controls.

### AI Campaign Assistant
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/products/ai-campaign-assistant

AI-assisted co-pilot (Pika Pilot) for drafting campaign concepts, audience rule suggestions, and message copy from natural language prompts. Internal product documentation describes an anonymized-parameter AI boundary where direct personal identifiers are intended to be excluded from LLM prompt context, and all dispatches require explicit human review.

### Use Cases
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/use-cases

Practical implementation scenarios illustrating customer retention, replenishment reminders, win-back flows, and VIP rewards.

## Commercial Model & Pricing

Pika operates strictly on a quotation-based commercial model. No fixed package prices or public pricing calculators are published.
Commercial quotations are customized based on:
- Customer / contact database volume
- Monthly transaction volume
- Messaging and channel dispatch volume (Email, SMS, WhatsApp)
- Onboarding and setup scope
- Integration requirements (ERP, CRM, e-commerce, custom APIs)
- Enabled product modules
- Support and service scope
- Contract terms

Primary commercial CTA: Request a Quote / Request a Demo via https://pika.tr/en/demo-request (Turkish: https://pika.tr/demo-talebi).
